entries.en: The wildlife researcher photographed a bird with albinism.
entries.zh: 野生动物研究者拍摄了一只患白化病的鸟。

entries.en: The Roman ampulla stood beside a dish decorated with vines.
entries.zh: 那只古罗马双耳细颈瓶摆在一个饰有葡萄藤图案的盘子旁。

entries.en: The pathology report includes a description of hyperemia in the tissue sample.
entries.zh: 病理报告中包括对组织样本充血的描述。

entries.en: The film's gruesome props grossed out several viewers.
entries.zh: 影片中令人毛骨悚然的道具让几位观众感到恶心。

entries.en: The health club added two rowing machines beside the pool.
entries.zh: 健身俱乐部在泳池旁添置了两台划船机。

entries.en: The researcher examined how migration altered each social relation within the village.
entries.zh: 研究者考察了迁移如何改变村内的各项社会关系。

entries.en: The novel's courier waited in a safe house outside the city.
entries.zh: 小说中的信使在城外的一处安全屋等候。

entries.en: The child borrowed a picture book about migrating birds.
entries.zh: 孩子借了一本关于候鸟迁徙的图画书。

entries.en: Each food product carried a label listing its ingredients.
entries.zh: 每种食品都贴有列明配料的标签。

entries.en: The discussion will center on the proposed library extension.
entries.zh: 讨论将以拟议的图书馆扩建为重点。

entries.en: The public health archive contains historical reports of shigellosis.
entries.zh: 公共卫生档案中保存着志贺氏菌病的历史报告。

entries.en: The waste audit separated putrescible material from glass and metal.
entries.zh: 废物审查将易腐物质与玻璃、金属分开。

entries.en: The sports museum displayed a basket used in pelota.
entries.zh: 体育博物馆展出了回力球运动中使用的一只篮形球拍。

entries.en: The damaged shipment set back our plans for the exhibition.
entries.zh: 货物受损使我们的展览计划受挫。

entries.en: The pupils collected fallen leaves for nature study.
entries.zh: 学生们为自然课收集了落叶。

entries.en: The twins will be born in the same town as their parents.
entries.zh: 这对双胞胎将出生在与父母相同的城镇。

entries.en: It was good luck that the missing parcel reached us before departure.
entries.zh: 真是好运，丢失的包裹在我们出发前送到了。

entries.en: Rain blurred the view through the car window.
entries.zh: 雨让透过车窗看到的景象变得模糊。

entries.en: Checking the tide became second nature after years of sailing.
entries.zh: 多年航海之后，查看潮汐成了第二天性。

entries.en: The outdoor concert is dependent on dry weather.
entries.zh: 户外音乐会能否举行取决于天气是否干燥。

entries.en: The nutrition worksheet expresses each energy estimate in kilocalories.
entries.zh: 营养学练习用千卡表示每项能量估算。

entries.en: The historical novel describes bottles of hootch hidden beneath the floor.
entries.zh: 历史小说描述了藏在地板下的一瓶瓶私酒。

entries.en: His whiney complaints continued long after we found the lost bag.
entries.zh: 我们找回丢失的包很久以后，他仍在哼哼唧唧地抱怨。

entries.meaningZh: 白人的负担（殖民主义观念）
entries.en: The seminar criticized the white man's burden as a justification for colonial rule.
entries.zh: 研讨课批评了以“白人的负担”为殖民统治辩护的观念。

entries.en: The guide spelled out the route before we left the harbor.
entries.zh: 离开港口前，向导把路线讲清楚了。

entries.en: The sudden price increase forced us to revise the budget.
entries.zh: 突然涨价迫使我们修改预算。

entries.en: A police officer directed traffic around the fallen tree.
entries.zh: 一名警察指挥车辆绕过倒下的树。

entries.en: The appeal discussed a disputed finding of fact in the original case.
entries.zh: 上诉讨论了原案中一项有争议的事实认定。

entries.en: The handbook explains the group insurance offered to employees.
entries.zh: 手册解释了向员工提供的团体保险。

entries.en: The path's hiddenness helped preserve the quiet garden.
entries.zh: 小路隐蔽，有助于保持花园的宁静。

entries.en: Engineers inspected the cofferdam before work began on the bridge pier.
entries.zh: 桥墩施工前，工程师检查了围堰。

entries.en: The old map shows the princedom bordered by two rivers.
entries.zh: 旧地图显示，这个亲王领地以两条河流为界。

entries.en: A city father proposed restoring the fountain in the square.
entries.zh: 一位市政要员提议修复广场上的喷泉。

entries.en: The historical map traces the battle group's movements across the valley.
entries.zh: 历史地图追踪了战斗群穿越山谷的行动。

entries.en: The skater traced a figure eight across the fresh ice.
entries.zh: 滑冰者在新冰面上滑出了一个八字形。

entries.en: The physics lecture compared the strong force with the electromagnetic force.
entries.zh: 物理讲座比较了强相互作用与电磁相互作用。

entries.en: Moving the tool cabinet improved the workshop's work flow.
entries.zh: 移动工具柜改善了车间的工作流程。

entries.en: She folded the air letter carefully before sealing it.
entries.zh: 她仔细折好航空信，再封上。

entries.en: The pharmacy inventory includes a separate entry for naloxone.
entries.zh: 药房库存清单为纳洛酮单列了一个条目。

entries.en: The pathology seminar discussed a recorded case of glomerulonephritis.
entries.zh: 病理学研讨课讨论了一例有记录的肾小球肾炎病例。

entries.en: The study compared two biotypes within the same insect species.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了同一昆虫物种中的两个生物型。

entries.en: A fox leaped out from the bushes and startled us.
entries.zh: 一只狐狸从灌木丛中跳出，吓了我们一跳。

entries.en: The vessel slowed as it met a heavy head sea.
entries.zh: 船遇到猛烈的迎头浪时减慢了速度。

entries.en: The technician replaced the damaged mother board before testing the computer.
entries.zh: 技术员更换了损坏的主机板，再测试电脑。

entries.en: A cost increase in timber delayed the renovation.
entries.zh: 木材成本增加，延误了翻修。

entries.en: The boat trip was the high spot of our holiday.
entries.zh: 乘船游览是我们假期中最精彩的部分。

entries.en: The photograph occupied a full page in the magazine.
entries.zh: 这张照片占据了杂志中的一整页。

entries.en: They made over the empty warehouse into an art studio.
entries.zh: 他们把空仓库改成了一间艺术工作室。

entries.en: A narrow stream separates the ploughland from the orchard.
entries.zh: 一条窄溪把耕地与果园隔开。

entries.en: The surgical atlas includes an illustration labeled thoracotomy.
entries.zh: 外科图谱中有一幅标为开胸术的插图。

entries.en: The editor disabled automatic hyphenation in the narrow text columns.
entries.zh: 编辑关闭了窄文本栏中的自动断字功能。

entries.en: She seemed to live over the voyage whenever she opened the old diary.
entries.zh: 每次打开旧日记，她仿佛都在重温那次航行。

entries.en: In the cartoon, the emperor stepped outside naked as a jaybird.
entries.zh: 漫画中，皇帝光着身子走了出去。

entries.en: Could you watch over the sleeping child while I answer the door?
entries.zh: 我去应门时，你能照看一下睡着的孩子吗？

entries.en: Dad blew a fuse when he saw the broken window.
entries.zh: 爸爸看见破窗户时大发雷霆。

entries.en: Stars filled the vault of heaven above the desert camp.
entries.zh: 沙漠营地上方的天穹中布满星星。

entries.en: The psycholinguist studied how children recognized unfamiliar words.
entries.zh: 心理语言学家研究了儿童如何识别陌生词语。

entries.en: The fair's palmist sat beneath a striped canvas awning.
entries.zh: 集市上看手相的人坐在条纹帆布棚下。

entries.en: The rescuers used a heavy tool to break open the jammed door.
entries.zh: 救援人员用重型工具砸开了卡住的门。

entries.en: The clock's hour hand pointed between four and five.
entries.zh: 钟的时针指在四与五之间。

entries.en: A retired air force officer donated the uniform to the museum.
entries.zh: 一位退休空军军官把这套制服捐给了博物馆。

entries.en: The training map marks the target area in red.
entries.zh: 训练地图用红色标出了目标区域。

entries.en: She checked the outside door before going upstairs.
entries.zh: 她上楼前检查了外门。

entries.en: We picked over the apples and removed the bruised ones.
entries.zh: 我们逐个挑选苹果，把碰伤的剔了出来。

entries.en: The supplier checked the customer's open account, which still showed several unpaid orders.
entries.zh: 供应商核对了客户的未清结账目，其中仍列有几笔尚未付款的订单。

entries.en: The roily water swirled around the bridge supports.
entries.zh: 翻腾的浑水在桥墩周围打旋。

entries.en: The laboratory report groups compounds by their recorded teratogenic effects.
entries.zh: 实验室报告按记录中的致畸作用对化合物分组。

entries.en: The final movement develops a fugal passage for the strings.
entries.zh: 最后一个乐章为弦乐展开了一段赋格风格的乐句。

entries.en: The actor carried a bow and arrow made for the stage production.
entries.zh: 演员携带着为舞台演出制作的弓箭。

entries.en: The documentary examines conditions in an old state prison.
entries.zh: 纪录片考察了一座旧州监狱的内部状况。

entries.en: The seminar compared visual sense experience with descriptions based on memory.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了视觉感觉经验与基于记忆的描述。

entries.en: The potential buyer requested financial records from the target company.
entries.zh: 潜在买方要求目标公司提供财务记录。

entries.en: Sailing was the first water sport she tried.
entries.zh: 帆船是她尝试的第一项水上运动。

entries.en: The historical account describes a military force stationed beside the river.
entries.zh: 这份历史记述描述了一支驻扎在河边的军队。

entries.en: The worksheet calculates simple interest on a hypothetical loan.
entries.zh: 练习计算了一笔假设贷款的单利。

entries.en: The two diagrams show nonequivalent arrangements of the same components.
entries.zh: 两幅图示显示了相同部件的两种非等价排列。

entries.en: The bibliographer checked the publication date of every listed edition.
entries.zh: 书目编制者核对了所列每个版本的出版日期。

entries.en: The teaching file contains an anonymized case labeled pneumothorax.
entries.zh: 教学档案中有一例标为气胸的匿名化病例。

entries.en: The students compared letters reproduced in the source book.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了原始资料集中复制的信件。

entries.en: The storm damaged the village telephone system.
entries.zh: 暴风雨损坏了村里的电话系统。

entries.en: The council discussed public security around the crowded station.
entries.zh: 议会讨论了拥挤车站周围的治安。

entries.en: The scholarship gave her opportunities undreamed of during her school years.
entries.zh: 奖学金给她带来了学生时代梦想不到的机会。

entries.en: The debugger highlighted the program line containing the missing bracket.
entries.zh: 调试器高亮显示了缺少括号的程序行。

entries.en: The costume designer stitched the hem of the kirtle.
entries.zh: 服装设计师缝好了那件女长袍的下摆。

entries.en: The medical history display includes early equipment used for fluoroscopy.
entries.zh: 医学史展览中包括早期用于透视检查的设备。

entries.en: The historian examined the use of cretinism in older medical records.
entries.zh: 历史学家考察了旧医疗记录中“呆小症”这一名称的使用。

entries.en: The device keeps its startup code in read-only storage.
entries.zh: 设备把启动代码保存在只读存储器中。

entries.en: The ranger stamped out the small fire beside the path.
entries.zh: 护林员踩灭了小路旁的小火。

entries.en: The producer edited out a long pause before releasing the recording.
entries.zh: 制作人在发布录音前删掉了一段长停顿。

entries.en: You should by all means ask for a receipt before leaving.
entries.zh: 离开前，你一定要索取收据。

entries.en: The experiment measured the liquid's residence time in the mixing chamber.
entries.zh: 实验测量了液体在混合室中的停留时间。

entries.en: The mission log records the transmission time of the signal sent to the spacecraft.
entries.zh: 任务日志记录了向航天器发送信号的发射时间。

entries.en: The research director approved the laboratory's new schedule.
entries.zh: 研究主任批准了实验室的新日程。

entries.en: The study compared genotypic differences between the two plant populations.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了两个植物种群的基因型差异。

entries.en: The archived pharmacy inventory lists succinylcholine on a separate page.
entries.zh: 存档的药房库存清单在单独一页列出了琥珀酰胆碱。

entries.en: His furtiveness made the guard ask to see his pass.
entries.zh: 他鬼鬼祟祟的样子，让卫兵要求查看他的通行证。

entries.en: The committee drummed out the treasurer after discovering the missing funds.
entries.zh: 委员会发现资金失踪后，把财务主管赶了出去。

entries.en: The wide area network connects the company's offices across three countries.
entries.zh: 广域网连接着公司在三个国家的办公室。

entries.en: The hotel hosted a social function for the visiting delegates.
entries.zh: 酒店为来访代表举办了一场社交聚会。

entries.en: The dog shook off the rain before entering the kitchen.
entries.zh: 狗进厨房前甩掉了身上的雨水。

entries.en: We had the good fortune to find a guide before the storm.
entries.zh: 我们很幸运，在风暴来临前找到了一位向导。

entries.en: Old habits die hard, even after the office rules change.
entries.zh: 即使办公室规章改变了，旧习惯也很难改掉。

entries.en: The critic objected to the film's unkind portrayal of an older woman as a frump.
entries.zh: 评论家反对影片把一位年长女性刻薄地描绘成邋遢女人。

entries.en: The tablecloth's cutwork formed a border of small flowers.
entries.zh: 桌布上的镂空刺绣组成了一圈小花边饰。

entries.en: The anatomy model shows the pericardium surrounding the heart.
entries.zh: 解剖模型展示了包围心脏的心包。

entries.en: She joined the civil service after passing the entrance examination.
entries.zh: 她通过入职考试后，进入了文职部门。

entries.en: The former workshop is now a museum in its own right.
entries.zh: 这间旧作坊如今本身就是一座博物馆。

entries.en: The sailor sorted the small stuff before repairing the rigging.
entries.zh: 水手在修理索具前整理了细绳索。

entries.en: The class performed a dramatic work written by a former pupil.
entries.zh: 全班演出了一部由校友创作的戏剧作品。

entries.en: She kept the faded love letter inside a book of poems.
entries.zh: 她把褪色的情书保存在一本诗集中。

entries.en: The students folded paper to build an icosahedron.
entries.zh: 学生们折纸搭建了一个二十面体。

entries.en: The model generates price changes endogenously rather than importing them from outside.
entries.zh: 模型内生地产生价格变化，而不是从外部引入这些变化。

entries.en: The laboratory report includes a note documenting neutropenia.
entries.zh: 实验室报告中有一条记录中性白细胞减少的备注。

entries.en: The navigator drew a great circle on the globe.
entries.zh: 航海员在地球仪上画了一个大圆。

entries.en: The lecturer expanded the function as a power series around zero.
entries.zh: 讲师把函数在零点附近展开成幂级数。

entries.en: Each volunteer received the group's code of behavior.
entries.zh: 每位志愿者都收到了团体的行为准则。

entries.en: We punched out after the final delivery arrived.
entries.zh: 最后一批送货到达后，我们打卡下班。

entries.en: An old friend called out of the blue during lunch.
entries.zh: 午餐时，一位老朋友突然打来电话。

entries.en: The rehabilitation history describes a patient living with hemiplegia.
entries.zh: 康复病史描述了一位偏瘫患者的情况。

entries.en: The museum displayed a prototypic engine beside later models.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一台原型发动机与后来的型号并列展出。

entries.en: Her interest in epigraphy began with inscriptions on an old bridge.
entries.zh: 旧桥上的铭文让她开始对碑铭研究感兴趣。

entries.en: The physics seminar used an accelerating elevator to discuss the principle of equivalence.
entries.zh: 物理研讨课用加速电梯的例子讨论了等效原理。

entries.en: The library grouped economics and sociology under social science.
entries.zh: 图书馆把经济学和社会学归入社会科学。

entries.en: We decided to sack out in the cabin after the long hike.
entries.zh: 长途徒步后，我们决定在小屋里睡下。

entries.en: The teacher pointed to the time signature before counting the beats.
entries.zh: 老师先指出拍号，再数拍子。

entries.en: Someone left a parcel beside the front door.
entries.zh: 有人在前门旁留了一个包裹。

entries.en: She chose pale blue letter paper for the invitation.
entries.zh: 她为邀请函选了淡蓝色信纸。

entries.en: We managed to squeak by on the small emergency allowance.
entries.zh: 我们靠那点紧急补助勉强度日。

entries.en: The archive contains a quitclaim signed by the former owner.
entries.zh: 档案保存着一份由前业主签署的权利放弃文书。

entries.en: The stage fighter carried an iron-tipped quarterstaff during the historical reenactment.
entries.zh: 舞台打斗演员在历史重演中拿着一根铁头长木棍。

entries.en: The costumier fitted the dancers with new velvet capes.
entries.zh: 戏服供应商为舞者配好了新的天鹅绒披风。

entries.en: The dog barked like mad when the delivery van arrived.
entries.zh: 送货车到达时，狗疯狂地叫了起来。

entries.en: The museum displayed the inventor's patent of invention beside the prototype.
entries.zh: 博物馆在原型旁展出了发明者的发明专利证书。

entries.en: The trust company sent the beneficiaries an annual statement.
entries.zh: 信托公司向受益人寄送了年度报表。

entries.en: The historian compared the two nations' sea power before the war.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了两国战前的海上力量。

entries.en: Her body language showed discomfort before she answered the question.
entries.zh: 她还没回答问题，肢体语言就显出了不自在。

entries.en: The morning star shone above the eastern horizon before sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出前，启明星在东方地平线上方闪耀。

entries.en: The chemistry inventory distinguishes mercuric salts from other mercury compounds.
entries.zh: 化学库存清单区分了二价汞盐与其他汞化合物。

entries.en: The diagram compares embryonal development in two species.
entries.zh: 图示比较了两个物种的胚胎发育。

entries.en: The technician inserted an attenuator before measuring the signal.
entries.zh: 技术员在测量信号前接入了一个衰减器。

entries.en: The high jump competition began after the track events.
entries.zh: 径赛项目结束后，跳高比赛开始了。

entries.en: News of the closure leaked out before the official announcement.
entries.zh: 关闭的消息在正式公告之前泄漏了出去。

entries.en: The antique dinner service was missing two plates.
entries.zh: 那套古董餐具缺了两个盘子。

entries.en: The tower gave us a bird's eye view of the harbor.
entries.zh: 我们从塔上鸟瞰了港口。

entries.en: The botanist classified each mature plant by its life form.
entries.zh: 植物学家按生活型对每株成熟植物分类。

entries.en: The manual describes a control operation that starts the data transfer.
entries.zh: 手册描述了一项启动数据传输的控制操作。

entries.en: The film's bad guy steals the village's emergency supplies.
entries.zh: 影片中的坏人偷走了村里的应急物资。

entries.en: The factory's closedown left the town without its largest employer.
entries.zh: 工厂关闭后，镇上失去了最大的雇主。

entries.en: The clinical photograph shows an eschar beside a scale marker.
entries.zh: 临床照片显示了一块焦痂，旁边有比例尺标记。

entries.en: Her claim that the clock predicts earthquakes is bunkum.
entries.zh: 她声称这只钟能预知地震，纯属胡说。

entries.en: The former cover girl donated her early magazine portraits to the exhibition.
entries.zh: 这位前封面女郎把早期杂志肖像捐给了展览。

entries.en: He coughed out some phlegm during the examination.
entries.zh: 检查时，他咳出了一些痰。

entries.en: The new railway brought a sea change in the town's trade.
entries.zh: 新铁路使镇上的贸易发生了彻底转变。

entries.en: A cheerful "trick or treat" greeted us when we opened the door.
entries.zh: 我们打开门时，迎来了一声欢快的“不给糖就捣蛋”。

entries.en: The diagram draws a field line through each marked point.
entries.zh: 图示通过每个标记点画了一条场线。

entries.en: The historian examined arguments about free love in nineteenth-century pamphlets.
entries.zh: 历史学家考察了十九世纪小册子中关于自由性爱的论争。

entries.en: Both clocks struck midnight at the same time.
entries.zh: 两只钟同时敲响了午夜钟声。

entries.en: The old photograph shows a bleacher handling rolls of cloth.
entries.zh: 旧照片显示，一位漂白工正在搬动成卷的布。

entries.en: We left the autostrada before reaching the mountain village.
entries.zh: 还没到山村，我们就驶离了高速公路。

entries.en: The museum's financial exhibit includes an old government bond issued by the United States Treasury.
entries.zh: 博物馆的金融展品中包括一张美国财政部发行的旧公债。

entries.en: She bought new sheets during the department store's white sale.
entries.zh: 她在百货商店的家用纺织品促销时买了新床单。

entries.en: The missing receipts landed the treasurer in hot water.
entries.zh: 收据丢失，让财务主管陷入了困境。

entries.en: This route is easier by a long shot.
entries.zh: 这条路线远远更容易走。

entries.en: The training course distinguishes line management from advisory roles.
entries.zh: 培训课程区分了业务线管理与顾问职能。

entries.en: The committee remained firm despite repeated demands to cancel the concert.
entries.zh: 尽管有人反复要求取消音乐会，委员会仍坚定不移。

entries.en: The fisherman carried his coracle down to the river.
entries.zh: 渔夫把那只柳条骨架的小船搬到了河边。

entries.en: The anatomy student identified the crus between the knee and ankle.
entries.zh: 解剖学学生辨认出了膝与踝之间的小腿。

entries.en: The medical history lecture discussed the use of tamponade in early surgery.
entries.zh: 医学史讲座讨论了早期外科中的填塞技术。

entries.en: Their food supplies lasted out until the relief ship arrived.
entries.zh: 他们的食品供应一直维持到救援船抵达。

entries.en: We use a shared list to keep track of each delivery.
entries.zh: 我们用共享清单跟踪每次送货。

entries.en: Military music accompanied the parade through the square.
entries.zh: 队伍穿过广场时，有军乐伴奏。

entries.en: The old air base now houses an aviation museum.
entries.zh: 旧空军基地如今设有一座航空博物馆。

entries.en: The ice show ended with all the skaters on the rink.
entries.zh: 冰上表演结束时，所有滑冰演员都在冰场上。

entries.en: She sounded out the committee before proposing a new meeting time.
entries.zh: 她提议新的开会时间前，先试探了委员会的意见。

entries.en: The biology diagram labels a ribosome beside the strand of RNA.
entries.zh: 生物学图示在核糖核酸链旁标出了一个核糖体。

entries.en: The laboratory report records the products collected after pyrolysis.
entries.zh: 实验室报告记录了热解后收集的产物。

entries.en: The macroeconomist compared employment trends across three regions.
entries.zh: 宏观经济学家比较了三个地区的就业趋势。

entries.en: The kitten's face began to round out as it grew.
entries.zh: 随着小猫长大，它的脸开始变得圆润丰满。

entries.en: They fitted out the research boat with new recording equipment.
entries.zh: 他们为研究船配备了新的记录设备。

entries.en: The power station's old turbine hall is open to visitors.
entries.zh: 发电站的旧涡轮机大厅向游客开放。

entries.en: The carved figures stand in high relief against the stone background.
entries.zh: 雕刻的人物以高浮雕形式突出于石质背景。

entries.en: Please cross out the duplicate names before printing the list.
entries.zh: 打印名单前，请划掉重复的名字。

entries.meaningZh: 船舶可调转方向的宽广水域
entries.en: The captain kept ample sea room while passing the rocky coast.
entries.zh: 船长驶过岩石海岸时，留出了充足的海上回旋空间。

entries.en: The biography portrays the long-distance runner as an iron man of extraordinary endurance.
entries.zh: 传记把这位长跑运动员描写成耐力非凡的铁人。
